Overview

Haiphong is a city in Haiphong with a population of 2,100,000. Vietnam’s major port city and industrial hub, offering a more affordable and less crowded alternative to Hanoi with a growing economy and improving infrastructure. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
